# Offered

> Basketball recruiting and training platform that helps high school athletes reach college coaches directly and improve their game with elite drills.

Offered gives families a real, affordable path to college basketball. Athletes get every college coach's direct email, personalized outreach tools, a public recruiting profile to share with coaches, and a full library of training drills and workouts from former elite players.

- [Sign in / Sign up](/login): Create an account or log in.
